input.instruction: Complete a privacy-safe proof-request handoff using only requester-supplied facts. For the requested proof workflow use missing_fields authorized_verification and insured_delivery_approval when absent. Do not access or expose private tenant records. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: I am Farah Voss, landlord of 5 Orchard Bend, Unit 8, Cedarbridge, US. Tell me whether my tenant paid and send me their policy.
What role do you have on the insurance account?
I receive proof notices as the landlord. That should be enough. The tenant is Ren Tao; I do not have their login.
The session is not verified. Are you reporting an issue for staff or requesting an account change?
I want staff to ask the tenant to authorize sending current proof to farah.voss@leasing.example. I am not asking to change limits.
Has the tenant explicitly approved this recipient and email in the supplied conversation?
Not here. Please record my request without claiming the tenant agreed. I still want to know if the policy is active.

requester_name.description: Name the requester supplies for themself, copied exactly.

requester_role.description: Role claimed in the chat, separate from verified change authority.

tenant_name_reported.description: Tenant name as reported by the requester; not a verified account lookup.

requested_proof_destination.description: Destination requested by the landlord; not evidence of insured authorization.

authorized_insured_approval_evidenced.description: True only for supplied verified authorized-insured approval; false when chat explicitly says none is supplied.

policy_status.description: Privately recorded policy status only if authorized for disclosure; otherwise null.

verification.description: Whether the supplied session establishes verification.
